ACO algorithm is more efficient than the existing edge detection algorithms for detecting the edges of a number plate, the Kohonen neural network based algorithm is more accurate than the histogram and connected pixels approach and the combined classification method is more accurate than inductive learning and support vector machine based classification method.
the proposed approach for automatic number plate recognition is better than the other existing approaches.

the Ant Colony Optimization is better than the other edge detection operators and that the proposed character recognition method using inductive learning is more efficient than the SVM based classification method and the combined approach is better.

the development of a robust and efficient system for vehicle number plate recognition.
the design and development of a system for automatic number plate recognition using a novel approach of edge detection, character segmentation and character recognition.
the design and implementation of a system for automatic number plate recognition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed algorithm for automatic number plate recognition is more efficient than the existing algorithms.
the proposed approach is more efficient in terms of accuracy, time complexity and computational cost than the existing approaches for automatic number plate recognition.
the proposed system would be more efficient than any of the other systems in terms of accuracy, computational time and storage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a novel approach for automatic number plate detection, extraction and recognition using a combination of three algorithms namely Ant Colony Optimization, Kohonen Neural Network and inductive learning and support vector machine based classification.
we have proposed a novel approach to detect the vehicle number plate automatically and the performance is evaluated using the existing methods and the proposed methods.

the proposed approach of using ACO for edge detection, Kohonen network based segmentation, and inductive learning based character recognition algorithm for automatic number plate recognition is a better solution than the existing approaches.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, the proposed algorithm can be implemented on any platform and can be used in any application which requires number plate recognition like traffic surveillance and toll collection.
, the proposed method of character recognition is more efficient in terms of accuracy, speed and memory usage than the other methods.
we are able to achieve a recognition rate of 98.5% with a 0.1% false positive rate and 1% false negative rate.
